[SYNTHETIC FIXTURE DATA]{.bs-status-label}

This route exists only to review the shared Analysis Results Viewer. The values below are deliberately synthetic. They are not GNU, Sage, research, or published Analyzer results.
:::

The viewer loads through a small local `loadAnalysis(id)` boundary. When accepted Node or corpus JSON is ready, the data adapter can change without replacing this renderer.

:::

```{=html}
<div
  class="bs-analysis-results-host"

></div>
```
